```
public static <V, E> IsomorphicGraphMapping<V, E> identity(Graph<V, E> graph) {
    return graph.getVertex2VertexMap()
                .entrySet()
                .stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                        entry -> entry.getKey(),
                        entry -> entry.getValue()));
}
```

The method takes a `Graph` object as an input and returns an `IsomorphicGraphMapping` object. The `IsomorphicGraphMapping` object represents a mapping of the input graph to itself. The mapping is computed by returning a map that contains the same vertex as the input graph, with the same vertex mapped to itself.

The method first gets the vertex-to-vertex map of the input graph using `graph.getVertex2VertexMap()`. It then converts the map to a stream using `entrySet().stream()`, and collects the results using `Collectors.toMap()`. The resulting map contains the same vertex as the input graph, with the same vertex mapped to itself.
